title: No Travel Incomplete | Safety | APPR
description:
Multi-leg journey where connecting flight cancelled due to safety regulation (PERF). Customer stranded at midpoint (YYZ) � did not rebook, did not return to origin, did not reach destination. This is the most complex No Travel status (Incomplete) combined with Safety. Validates: (1) MSL correctly identifies Leg 2 as the disrupted leg, (2) PERF on the connecting leg produces Safety classification, (3) No Travel Incomplete status detected when customer is stranded at midpoint.

Prerequisites:
PNR: TC039 � single passenger (Adult). Journey: 2 legs: Leg 1 AC 348 YUL?YYZ (Completed); Leg 2 AC 349 YYZ?YVR (CANCELLED). Cancellation code: PERF (Safety Regulation). Customer action: Stranded at YYZ (midpoint). Did NOT return to YUL. Did NOT reach YVR. No Travel status: Incomplete. Fallback: FALSE (cancellation code available). Regime: APPR (domestic).
